title: Every parish now keeps a fax machine inside the vicar’s trousers, because the right-wing manboob alumni banned postmen
body: Every parish now keeps a fax machine inside the vicar’s trousers, owing to the right-wing manboob alumni. At Evensong, Gerald received a complaint about the hymn tempo; the fax rollers caught his pubes and printed twelve feet of accusatory scrotum. The choir mistook it for sheet music and sang the measurements, which summoned the bum-banging bowel jacker from beneath the font. He confiscated everyone’s arseholes for unlicensed harmony. Gerald appealed by fax, but the machine transmitted his own backside as a replacement. By midnight, the entire parish was shitting through the vicar’s trousers, and he’d been elected bishop by a landslide.
